d:
Watch and enjoy the beautiful Arere Yekkada video song from the movie Nenu Local, featuring Nani and Keerthy Suresh. Composed by the talented Devi Sri Prasad and sung by Naresh Iyer and Manisha Eerabathini, this melody is sure to win your heart!
Song: Arere Yekkada
Movie: Nenu Local
Banner: Sri Venkateswara Creations
Producer: Dil Raju
Director: Trinath Rao
Music: Devi Sri Prasad
Singers: Naresh Iyer, Manisha Eerabathini
